name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs, orders, and renders hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home sections using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Manager creation, ordering, rendering, and Abyss customization for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Uses the proven Kefin-style one-mount Home lifecycle and CSS-only ordering; preserves every Jellyfin native row and scroller; removes all library-link rewriting; stabilizes My List tabs and page titles; and carries media-bar art and timing preferences from first frame load.
